def transform(grid):
    """Return the four rotations of a square grid in a 2x2 arrangement."""
    n = len(grid)
    if n == 0 or any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a non-empty square grid")
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return ([grid[i][:] + clockwise[i] for i in range(n)] +
            [counterclockwise[i] + half[i] for i in range(n)])
PY
